newsitem.title: USA: ATEC Group buys VDOT.NET Internet provider.
newsitem.headline: ATEC Group buys VDOT.NET Internet provider.

text.p: ATEC Group Inc said Thursday it had bought VDOT.NET Inc, a privately-held Internet service provider, for undisclosed terms.
The company said additionally that it intends to "seek out additional acquisitions in the Internet and Software area to increase our existing revenue base and increase profit margins."
On September 10 ATEC reported record results for the year ended June 30, 1996. It said fiscal 1996 revenues were $81,812,045, up 72 percent from $47,565,542 for the prior year.
ATEC specializes in enterprise-wide technology solutions, primarily for small to mid-sized companies and government agencies.
